title: GOA canonical speaking evaluation
description:
SPEAK-EVAL-003. The one shape a speaking evaluation takes, whatever produced it.

Before this schema the practice WebSocket, the exam holistic endpoint, the persisted JSONB, the eval runner and the frontend each had their own idea of a result, and they had already drifted: a criterion that timed out carried band 0.0 in one place and an absent key in another, and nothing anywhere recorded which model, prompt or rubric produced a score.

Two rules run through every definition here:

1. STATUS IS SEPARATE FROM VALUE. A criterion that did not complete has status 'unavailable' and NO band. Band 0.0 is a real IELTS value meaning the candidate said nothing usable; it must never stand in for 'we did not measure this'. This is the BUG-055 defect class, and it has recurred often enough in this codebase to be worth encoding in the type system.

2. EVERY CLAIM IS ADDRESSABLE. A rubric match names a descriptor id from the frozen rubric. Evidence names a transcript offset, an audio interval or a measurement id. A validator resolves all of them before the result is shown, so a displayed reason is checkable rather than merely fluent.

schema_version.description: Every representation carries this. A breaking field or meaning change creates v2; additive optional fields may stay v1 only if older consumers ignore unknown keys safely.

evaluation_id.description: Stable id for this evaluation. A re-score creates a NEW evaluation linked to the prior one, never an overwrite.

mode.description: Which transport produced this. The scoring core is identical across all three; only the envelope differs. 'benchmark' exists so an eval run is never mistaken for a user's result.

status.description: complete: every requested criterion scored. partial: at least one scored, at least one did not. failed: none scored. A 'failed' evaluation still carries per-criterion reasons; it is not an empty object.

score_semantics.description: Fixed, and deliberately not 'ielts_band'. This system is not a certified examiner and the product must not imply it is. Widening this enum requires evidence that the claim is true.

criterionId.description: The four official IELTS speaking criteria. Snake_case ids rather than the display strings ('Fluency and Coherence') the swarm currently keys its map by: a display string is a label, and labels change. GOA-133 renamed pronunciation in the UI without touching this id, which is exactly the separation this buys.

status.description: 'unavailable' covers every way a criterion can fail to produce a score: provider error, deadline, unparseable output, or an input the criterion cannot be assessed from.

band.description: Present if and only if status is 'scored'. Enforced by the allOf below, not merely by convention.

unavailable_reason.description: Present if and only if status is 'unavailable'. 'insufficient_evidence' is the honest answer when the input cannot support the criterion at all -- e.g. pronunciation with no acoustic features.

summary.description: One or two sentences for the student. Not the place for hedging or for restating the band.

measurements.description: Ids into provenance.measurements. Referenced rather than inlined so one measured value cannot disagree with itself across two criteria.

limitations.description: What this score does NOT cover. Required in practice for pronunciation until acoustic analysis exists; the criterion currently reasons from recognition confidence and pause structure, which is not the same thing as assessing sounds.

band.description: Half-band steps only. A band of 6.3 is not an IELTS score, and accepting one would mean some upstream rounding rule was skipped.

descriptor_id.description: Stable id into the frozen rubric, e.g. 'fc.7'. The model may cite ONLY ids supplied in its request; a validator rejects anything else, which is what stops a plausible-sounding descriptor being invented.

polarity.description: supports: the response meets this descriptor. caps_below: this is why the band is not higher. reaches_toward: partial evidence of the band above. The second is what lets an explanation answer 'why not a 7' rather than only 'why a 6'.

application.description: How this descriptor applies to THIS response. One sentence, concrete.

supports_claim.description: What this evidence is evidence FOR. Evidence attached to nothing is decoration.

quote.description: Exact text at the stated offsets. A validator re-reads the transcript at char_start..char_end and rejects a mismatch, so a paraphrase presented as a quote cannot ship.

action.description: Concrete and doable. 'Improve your fluency' is not an action.

because.description: The observation this action responds to, tying advice back to evidence rather than to a generic template.

band.description: ABSENT when fewer than min_criteria_required criteria scored. Not null, not zero -- absent. A band averaged from one surviving agent describes which agents survived, not the candidate (BUG-040).

unrounded_mean.description: The mean before IELTS rounding. Shown so a student can see the arithmetic instead of being asked to trust it, and so a discrepancy between mean and band is detectable.

included_criteria.description: Exactly the criteria that contributed. Unavailable ones are excluded here AND from the mean.

rounding_rule.description: Versioned id of the rounding applied, e.g. 'ielts_half_band_v1'. Named rather than assumed so a change to it is visible in stored results.

min_criteria_required.description: The policy threshold in force when this was scored. Stored per-result because it is a product decision that may change, and an old result must still explain itself.

scope.description: What the value was computed over. A pause count means different things per-answer and per-session.

provenance.description: What produced this score. Enough to reproduce it, or at least to explain why it cannot be reproduced.

llm_model.description: The EFFECTIVE model, read from configuration at call time. This was hardcoded to a Haiku id in the Langfuse span while the service ran Opus, which made every model-to-model telemetry comparison meaningless.

audio_format.description: The declared container, e.g. 'audio/webm'. Recorded because SPEAK-EVAL-002 established that a mislabelled format silently produces a score from noise.

measurements.description: Every measured value referenced by any criterion, stored once.

cost_usd.description: Null, never 0.0, when the model is absent from the shared price table (GOA-135). 'We could not price this' and 'this was free' are different facts.
